mechanics.claim: The rupture damages after a delay from cast, separate from the cast time.
mechanics.quote: The delay before the rupture does not include the cast time.

mechanics.claim: Cleansing the airborne does not prevent the slow.
mechanics.quote: Cleansing the airborne will not prevent the slow.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield can block the airborne, which also prevents the slow, but cannot block the slow itself.
mechanics.quote: The slow itself can also not be blocked by spell shield, but will always be prevented if the airborne was.

mechanics.claim: The area still ruptures (and deals damage) even if Cho'Gath dies during the delay.
mechanics.quote: The area will still rupture even if Cho'Gath dies during the delay.
